title: MaineCare
before:
School districts may be required to offer certain medical services to students, often covered or partially covered by MaineCare. The Maine Department of Education directs you to the DHHS MaineCare in Education School Health-Related Services for MaineCare information and all MaineCare-related questions.

 MaineCareInEducation2024SchoolHealth-RelatedServicesGuide, PDF, 375KB

MaineCare has established a special list serve for school based medical services. To enroll in this list serve, you may sign-up online.

Providers

 

Email Inquiries: MainecareEnroll@gainwelltechnologies.com. 

Provider Services Call Center: 1-866-690-5585, Option 2 for Enrollment Questions. TTY users dial 711.

Provider Services Call Center: 1-866-690-5585, Option 7 for Revalidation Questions. TTY users dial 711.

Other Provider Services:

For MIHMS and Health PAS Online Portal questions, call 1-866-690-5585. TTY users dial 711 or send an email to: MaineCareProvider@gainwelltechnologies.com.  

Provider Relations:

Provider: Relations Staff Assignments (PDF) for a list of specialists by policy.

  • School administrators and staff with any other MaineCare questions can send an email to MaineCareinEducation.DHHS@maine.gov, or contact Trista Collins, 207-624-4094, or email Trista.Collins@maine.gov.

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — MaineCareinEducation.DHHS@maine.gov → MaineCareinEducation.Dhhs@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 4 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
